en.meta.title: Veterinarian in Altkirch, near Basel | Maison Bleue Veterinary Clinic
en.meta.desc: Veterinary clinic in Altkirch (Alsace, France), 30 minutes from Basel, since 1986: appointments, surgery, X-ray, ultrasound, in-house lab and 24/7 emergencies. Book online.
en.nav.label: Main menu
en.hero.lead: Your veterinary clinic in Altkirch, in the heart of the Sundgau, 30 minutes from Basel. Our whole team is here to take care of your cats, dogs and small furry pets of every kind.
en.hero.alt: The renovated reception area of the veterinary clinic
en.soins.p: Consultation, imaging, surgery and hospitalisation: it all happens on site, at the clinic.
en.soins.astuce: Hover over or tap a card to see the room.
en.s0.p: Consultations, vaccinations, prevention and follow-up throughout your pet's life.
en.s1.p: A fully equipped operating room, so every procedure takes place in the best conditions.
en.s2.p: An on-site X-ray room for a fast diagnosis.
en.s3.p: A non-invasive, painless imaging exam to refine the diagnosis.
en.s4.p: Kennels to monitor and care for your animals when they need to stay with us.
en.s5.p: Tests run at the clinic, so results come without the wait.
en.eq.h2: Humans (and their furry and feathered friends)
en.eq.p: Veterinarians and nurses work side by side every day, so you always find a familiar face.
en.eq.alt: The whole clinic team in front of the Maison Bleue
en.hi.p: From a small practice on rue des Bons-Enfants to the blue house on Faubourg de Mulhouse.
en.h0.p: Mariella De Nies sets up on rue des Bons-Enfants in Altkirch.
en.h1.p: The practice becomes a clinic and moves to Faubourg de Mulhouse.
en.h2.p: Mathieu Grandjean becomes Mariella De Nies's partner.
en.h3.p: A larger reception area, air conditioning and a wheelchair ramp.
en.h4.p: Mathieu Grandjean takes over from Mariella De Nies.
en.vi.h2: Come in, let us show you around
en.a0: Yes, consultations are by appointment only: Monday to Friday from 9am to 12pm and 2pm to 7pm, and Saturday from 9am to 12pm. You can book online or by phone.
en.q1: What should I do in an emergency?
en.a1: Emergencies are covered 24/7. Call the clinic on +33 3 89 40 66 06: an on-call service runs at nights and weekends.
en.a2: Cats, dogs and small furry pets of every kind: the whole team is here to meet their needs.
en.a3: Yes, since its 2016 renovation the clinic has a wheelchair ramp and air-conditioned premises.
en.ur.p: Nights, weekends, public holidays: call us and we'll guide you.
